newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RTRS-Cricket-Another Blewett century sets up crushing victory.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Another Blewett century sets up crushing victory.

text.p: Greg Blewett's second successive century in South Africa set up another Australian innings victory as they humiliated Border by an innings and 105 runs on the second day of their three day match on Saturday.

Blewett's test-best 214 gave Australia the platform to thrash South Africa by an innings and 195 runs in the first test in Johannesburg last week and his 112 against a hopelessly outclassed Border team was instrumental in this victory.
